home.title: HeistMind - Forged in the Dark Platform
home.description: The definitive platform for Forged in the Dark campaigns. Create characters, run heists, forge your legacy in the shadows.

hero.title: The mechanical home for your Forged-in-the-Dark crew
hero.lead: Build rules-valid characters and crews, then keep them current wherever you play — at the table, or async on Discord. HeistMind handles the dice, gear, XP, clocks, and the campaign log so the rules never slow you down. The story's yours; the bookkeeping's ours.

table.title: At your table
table.body: A living, rules-valid character and crew sheet. Build a scoundrel in minutes; track stress, harm, XP, coin, and gear; and bring it to any Forged-in-the-Dark game — in person or on voice.

pbp.title: Play-by-post on Discord
pbp.body: The async mechanical layer for your game: rolls, clocks, stress, per-score gear, and a score-grouped campaign log that stays in sync as the story unfolds in your Discord channels.
pbp.tag: Like Avrae for D&D — but built for Forged in the Dark.

rules.title: Rules-driven
rules.body: Every action the app offers is legal for your ruleset, so you don't have to re-read the book. Correctness is built in.

anywhere.title: Track results from anywhere
anywhere.body: Roll in-app, on Discord, or just record what happened at the table — it all lands in one shared, score-grouped campaign log.

alacarte.title: Take what you want
alacarte.body: Just a character sheet, or crew tracking, or the full loop. Nothing is forced — adopt the pieces you need and leave the rest.

cta.heading: Ready to forge your crew?
cta.body: Sign in with Discord to spin up a campaign or join one with a code.
